title: 2005 AMC 10B Problem 13
statement: How many numbers between \(1\) and \(2005\) are integer multiples of \(3\) or \(4\) but not \(12?\)

solutions.text:
Between \(1\) and \(2005\) there are \(668\) multiples of \(3,\) \(501\) multiples of \(4,\) and \(167\) multiples of \(12.\)

Every multiple of \(12\) is both a multiple of \(3\) and of \(4,\) so removing them from each group gives \[ \begin{aligned} &(668 - 167) \\ &\quad {}+ (501 - 167) = 835 \end{aligned} \] numbers that are multiples of \(3\) or \(4\) but not \(12.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Count multiples of \(3\) and of \(4\) separately, noting that multiples of \(12\) are the overlap
